lms.crowd_note: Modelled — no pool publishes its picks. Roughly 16% of a typical field lands on Fulham, so this is a pick away from the crowd. About 44% of the field goes out this round, against your 31% — +13%. Early on that matters little, because a round that eliminates everybody is usually replayed; it matters most when the pool is down to a handful and you need the others to go out without you.
